title: Catalogue entry body shape v1alpha1
description: Declares the ordered body sections an entry of a given category must carry. Frontmatter is governed by the catalogue entry contract; this governs everything below it. Held as one resource rather than one per category, because the concern is section conformance and splitting it would fork the mechanism.

categories.description: One declaration per governed category. A category absent from this list is ungoverned, which is a stated gap rather than a silent one.

category.description: The catalogue category this shape governs. Matches the category field of the entries it applies to.

rationale.description: Why this shape, in one sentence. A shape with no stated reason is a convention that nobody can argue with.

ordered.description: Whether the sections must appear in the declared order. Order matters when the shape encodes a reading sequence, and does not when the sections are independent.

sections.description: Required level-two headings, in the order they must appear. Exact text, without the leading marker.
